what_to_detect: A resolution puts a card onto the battlefield under a player other than its owner: the permanent's controller is the player it entered under, its owner stays the card's owner.
near_miss: A resolution puts a card onto the battlefield under its owner, so controller and owner coincide.

what_to_detect: A resolution instructs a player other than the ability's controller to put an object onto the battlefield, and the object enters under the instructed player's control.
near_miss: A resolution in which the ability's own controller is the instructed player, so the object enters under the ability's controller.

what_to_detect: A permanent spell controlled on the stack by a player other than its owner resolves, and the permanent enters under the spell's controller.
near_miss: A permanent spell controlled by its owner resolves and enters under its owner.

what_to_detect: A resolution puts a permanent onto the battlefield without saying how it enters, and it enters untapped (no tapped event for it, tapped false afterwards).
near_miss: A resolution puts a permanent onto the battlefield and says it enters tapped, and it enters tapped.
record_fields: tapped event on the same subject

what_to_detect: A permanent keeps its face status (flipped) while an effect makes it a copy of another card, so it shows the copied card's flipped characteristics.
near_miss: An unflipped permanent becomes a copy of a flip card and shows the copied card's unflipped characteristics.
